description: Government schemes and scholarships for students in Karnataka

schemes.name: State Scholarship Portal (SSP) Post-Matric Scholarship
schemes.summary: Financial assistance for post-matriculation studies to eligible students of Karnataka.

requirements.criterion: The applicant must be a resident of Karnataka.
requirements.evidence: Candidate must be a domicile of Karnataka.

requirements.criterion: Annual family income must not exceed Rs 2,50,000.
requirements.evidence: Total family annual income from all sources should not exceed Rs 2.50 Lakhs.

documents.name: Income Certificate
documents.evidence: Valid RD-numbered Income Certificate issued by Revenue Department

documents.name: Caste Certificate
documents.evidence: Valid RD-numbered Caste Certificate issued by Revenue Department

documents.name: Admission Proof
documents.evidence: College admission letter or registration number

schemes.name: Vidyasiri (Food and Accommodation Scheme)
schemes.summary: Monthly stipend for SC/ST/OBC/minority students residing outside government hostels.

requirements.criterion: Annual family income must not exceed Rs 2,00,000.
requirements.evidence: Annual income threshold Rs 2 Lakhs for backward classes.

documents.name: Bank Passbook
documents.evidence: Bank account copy for direct benefit transfer

documents.name: Bonafide Certificate
documents.evidence: Study certificate issued by college head
